book.name: Talfut Kese
book.title: Sunbin-Got em Abiil so Kawin so Talfut Kelewse Sang te.

content: Beli, Yawe e siw beem tem biliw Noa so, kut samal so, am samal so, alik alik biim ibolow fukunse kale. Fukuneko, inim fian mak ok tikin dim kel dabalalei, e ok beelo daking dak dak fong so fong so kelewse kale.
Kelewsomelei, ok fuktem da matem talse ok fian beso, suuk ok fian beso, alik alik be kales angse kale.
Keko beli, 150 ding kesomelei, ok singelet singelet kelei,
ben kel kayow mali em guel ding be danese ding kabalak e, Noa em siw Alalat amgu tikin dim ditse kale.
Ok dang fole fole be iti singelet singelet kesomelei, king kel kayow em emisik ding kabalak e, amgu kang akal kaimse kale.
Kaimei, iti fu alew ding banimei, Noa e solow tem mak busuko,
awon guegnok atew mak dabalase kale. Dabalalei, awon be yambisomelei, kawin e tiow kese ding kabalak e, e teineko, iti telinba kese kale.
Keko beli, Noa e ibolow tiaktiak keko, bokolomele: “Ok fole fole be singelet ange sako?”, angesomelei, e awon abim atew mak akal dabalase kale.

Dabalase kate, awon e “Ok e kawin kasise ki kebe kai!”, angomi, em dim teinomin dim fenbiko, dim banim kelei, iti talse kale. Telei, Noa e akalem teing danong kut elo dako, awon beelo aluweko, iti am dase kale.
Dako, ding fenbelei, iti ben kel ding banime ding dim bakate, e awon abim atew be iti kut elo dabalase kale.

Dabalalei, kuinbelei, awon be iti Noa em fukun talse kale. Telei, Noa e atemete: Ais oliw em kon feis mak ning tamoko, de talse kale. De telei, Noa e kilele kal kelete: “Ok e fein singelet angeko, banimse kai!”, angse kale.
Keko beli, e iti ben kel ding mak fenbomelei, iti awon abim atew be kut elo dabalase kate, awon be iti telinba kese kale.

Beli, Noa em itol e 601 kese itol beem emisik kayow em emisik ding kele ding dim bakate, ok fole fole be singelet del kuw kelei, kawin iti tiow kese kale. Beli, Noa e siw beem tikin am kon fat keleweko, kiineng kelomete: “Ataan e, kawin tiow kele kai!”, angse kale.
Angei, auk teben kayow em mali em ketket ding dane ding kabalak e, kawin be fein tiow kese kale.
Kelei, Yawe e Noa elo bokolewomele:
“Kame, ku so, kom muluwel so, kom muluwel im kalel kusel so, alik alik yu siw tem be kolewko, kut unina!
Mesesem mesesem samal biso, awon biso, samal teing yan banim so, alik alik ikati kut unina! Uneko, kawin dim dak koyemew kano, i fukalako, men kaileko, al kelina!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Noa yelimeli bi siw be kolewko, kawin dim elo talsiliw kale.
Teliwi, mesesem mesesem samal biso, awon biso, samal teing yan banim biso, alik alik bikati siw tem koleweko, kawin dim elo talsiliw kale.

Keko beli, Noa e aik ayem mak fakalasomi, samal so, awon so, Sunbin-Got em kiin dim e tokotoko kebiliw samal alik alik im mutuk e makmak makmak kuluko, aik ayem beem dim dukusomi, weing dako, ilo kainbelei, Yawe elo “Weso! Seyo!”, dangse kale.

Dangei, Yawe e aik ayem beem takfol dong dong deik be kimileweko, “Kamge ati te!”, angeko, bokolomele: “Ne iti kawin be makso nam yakok keli te. Feinka! Kawtiw aul dim telbiko, fasel dim akati, diwkuw diwkuw i wa kukuw beem dulum elote kuw fukunkabiliw kai! Fein! Finik so biliw alik alik biilo iti kaneyemsi emdiw nam keyemi te.

Kawin dim kaleem baniminba keko, boke ding dim kabalak, wanin kaimin ding so, wanin wanbin ding so, aneng gilil ding so, aneng mamin ding so, am ken am ding so, am suuk so ding so, taw so mililiw so ding so, kaneko ding be nam banime te.”, angse kale.
